fails: Trigger insight claims the new owner's analysis was 'the first serious review of our performance in years'. The transcript gives no such timeframe, so this is an unsupported embellishment.
data.notes: The report keeps the Adyen results unknown, carries the international/US split, and builds all four expected messaging directions on real evidence: own numbers over averages, 'approvals' not 'authorization', an answer to local acquiring, and a named monthly reviewer. It mislabels the unverified 'Brazil and a couple in Europe' as fact. Its 'decided' section challenges the rep mainly with the late analysis, not the core coverage facts (no business review in 9–10 months, never met Stefan), and the 9–10 months appears only in the rep takeaway. It names 'Support and service' rather than 'Champion or access' as the runner-up, and the close omits which analysis findings are fixable and the follow-up to act on them to protect the US and position a win-back.
